messages.content: How many heads can I get after tossing 3 coins?

message.content:
When you toss three fair coins, the number of heads you can obtain ranges from **0 to 3**.  
In fact, the distribution is:

| Heads | Probability |
|-------|-------------|
| 0     | 1/8 (12.5 %) |
| 1     | 3/8 (37.5 %) |
| 2     | 3/8 (37.5 %) |
| 3     | 1/8 (12.5 %) |

So you could end up with none, one, two, or all three heads.
